name: com.clostra.newnode.internal.NewNode$BatteryLevelReceiver
description: NewNode (Clostra's decentralized content delivery SDK) listens for low-battery and battery-restored broadcasts. It pauses nearby-device discovery while the battery is low and resumes it when the battery recovers.
disableEffect: NewNode will not pause its nearby-device activity when the battery is low, so it may use more battery.
